outline.processing: South Korea geometry projected to an SVG path; geographic scale and city pins share the same projection

residenceSource: User provided city names; Park Jongchan corrected to Jecheon and Park Cheonbin added as Uljin. No street addresses used.
distanceMethod: Haversine great-circle distance between representative city coordinates. Not road distance or journey duration.
travelEstimates: Game-only estimates. No live timetable, route or fare service.
scenarios: Tourism sources are linked per region in dist/game-regions.js; venue mishaps and all dialogue are authored fiction.
